facts.text: Table mapping lets you rename tables during cloud migration or move fields to a different table or extension.
Multiple source tables cannot map to the same destination table; each target table needs one on-premises source.
Sign in to Business Central online, search for Cloud Migration Management, and select Manage Custom Tables.
Set Target Type, Extension Names, and Table Name to specify the target table.
Enter the Source Table Name as it appears in SQL, such as with company name and extension ID.
Keys in the on-premises and online tables must match for table renaming.
The online target table must have ReplicateData property set to true.
You can use Import and Export actions to manage table mapping definitions.
